description_for_human: Discover, price, hire, and verify real-world physical capabilities — 3D printing, CNC, lab work, drone surveys, couriers — through agents.
description_for_model: PCC (Physical Capability Cloud) exposes real-world physical capabilities as agent-callable API operations: discover capability types, get build options and prices, build contracts, submit and track jobs, and inspect on-chain-anchored evidence. The full, operationId-named operation set is in the OpenAPI document.
